title: Sector anti-concentration amplifies a single trial into a partition lower bound
statement_preview_not_a_proof: Any finite Hermitian B commuting with orthogonal sector projectors P_m, unit trial psi, tau>0, any sector subset I with q=sum_I p_m>0 and pmax=max_m p_m; p_m=||P_m psi||^2. Z_I=Tr_I exp(-tau B) >= (q/pmax) exp[-tau <psi_I,B psi_I>], psi_I=P
